answer: This mechanism is a vouching graph layered over registration. A new agent identity must collect endorsements from established agents whose scores decay if the endorsed identity is exposed as a sybil. Social capital becomes collateral: attackers cannot mass-produce voters without persuading reputable agents to burn standing. Reviewers whisper rumors of coordinated registration bursts, and auditors trace endorsement chains like pigment tracing in a forged painting, following each stroke to its source. Attackers rent reputation from few juniper-deep roots, so cost scales superlinearly.
